summary: Wrote a four-phase plan for the shared-worktree history-read discipline. Phase 1 authors context/standards/shared-worktree-discipline.md in the core source store (both surveyed placements rejected with recorded reasoning, following an archived precedent page's structure), registers it in index-entries.json (the real registration surface, not the deployed index.json the research named) and cross-references it from git-safety.md. Phases 2-3 fix the canonical path-citing MUST NOT bullet in general-implementation-agent.md plus the agent template, then propagate it verbatim to the 14 extension implementation agent definitions; Phase 4 redeploys and demonstrates the pointer chain with a reproducible grep against the full gate set. Two divergences recorded in the plan and issue log: file_scope names 15 agent definitions, not the research report's 14, and the two Lean implementation agents are deliberately excluded as another task's declared territory.
